rows.expected_reason: Dutch how-to question about swapping shifts, answered by FAQ F03. Reply in Dutch.
rows.got_reason: The ticket asks how to swap a shift, which is answered by FAQ F03. It is a simple how‑to question, so priority P4 and a reply is appropriate.
rows.back_translation:
Hello,

To swap a shift, open the shift in the app and tap "Offer swap". Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. The manager approves the swap under Rota → Requests. Manager approval is enabled by default; you can disable it under Settings → Rota.

Kind regards,
Roosterly Support

We read every idea. You can post feature requests on our public roadmap at roadmap.roosterly.nl, where you can also vote on ideas. We cannot promise a delivery date.

Kind regards,
Roosterly Support
